name: Big Magnum Harimoto-sensei
original_name: ビッグマグナム・張本先生
source:
Main character is dispatched to investigate mysterious secret society that hides inside St. Eric's high school. The granddaughter of the director, Elina, notices that she is being targeted by a secret society. Protagonist protects her, and gradually relations start to develop. Eventually Elina gets kidnapped in order to get some "treasure" sleeping in the school. Who will be victorious?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角受命调查圣埃里克高中内隐藏的神秘秘密社团。校长的孙女艾琳娜察觉自己正成为秘密社团的目标，主角于是保护她，两人的关系也逐渐加深。最终，艾琳娜为了取得沉睡在学校里的“宝藏”而遭到绑架。究竟谁能获得胜利？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
